Policy · Last updated August 11, 2026

Platform terms

Review status

Draft for owner and qualified legal review before public launch.

Pre-1.0 software

Kéire is under active development. Features, formats, compatibility, and availability may change. Production-readiness claims are limited to the documented validation evidence for a specific release.

Accounts and security

Users are responsible for their credentials, linked identities, devices, and organization membership actions. Publisher, moderator, and administrator access requires multi-factor authentication before public launch.

Content and licenses

Engine source is provided under its repository license. Marketplace products use their selected SPDX, Creative Commons, or approved custom license; claiming a product stores the exact accepted revision.

Availability

Kéire may block malicious artifacts, security-revoked versions, abusive accounts, or unsafe access. Delisted products may remain available to entitled owners unless a security revocation requires blocking them.
